title: ClickHouse Cloud access
description: The artifact epack-collector-clickhouse emits at artifacts/clickhouse.details.json: who can reach a ClickHouse Cloud organization through its console and API, and each configured service's database access settings. A value the collector could not read is null or absent, and the collector result records a gap for it. The collector checks its output against this schema when it emits.

collected_at_level.description: The collection level the artifact was made at. audit adds the inventories to trust's counts, and internal adds nothing more.
